title: Agent Board
description: A multi-tool AI coding agent fleet manager that auto-discovers and orchestrates sessions across OpenCode, Cursor AI, Antigravity and Claude Code — with a black, gold & white UI and 24/7 mobile access.
detailedDescription: Agent Board is a high-performance command center for managing a fleet of AI coding agents across multiple tools. It automatically scans your machine for OpenCode, Cursor AI, Antigravity and Claude Code sessions and normalizes them into a single unified fleet view. Agents can be filtered by engine and role (BUILD, PLAN, EXPLORE, GENERAL), monitored through live status beacons, and inspected in detail — including tasks, message transcripts, tool executions and model telemetry. Sessions can be deactivated to prevent token burn or steered with manual prompt directives. The server listens on all network interfaces and exposes your local Wi-Fi IP so you can monitor the dashboard from your phone on the same network, and the app is packaged as a downloadable Electron desktop companion. The UI ships with a luxury black, gold & white palette and full dark/light theme support.

title: Wordle Arena
description: A multi-game daily word-puzzle platform (Wordle, Spelling Bee, Connections and more) built with Next.js 16, PostgreSQL/Prisma and server-validated game logic, with a full admin dashboard.
detailedDescription: Wordle Arena is a multi-game daily word-puzzle site that bundles Wordle, Spelling Bee, Connections and more into one platform. Every game uses a rotation bucket computed in IST — daily puzzles roll over at 00:00 and twelve-hour puzzles at 00:00 and 12:00 — and a deterministic HMAC-based fallback guarantees a puzzle always resolves even if no scheduler runs. Admins can override any word from the dashboard without it being overwritten by automation. The platform ships with secure authentication (bcrypt passwords, opaque SHA-256-hashed session tokens in HTTP-only cookies), optional guest play, rate limiting, CSRF origin checks and hardened security headers. Guesses are validated and scored entirely on the server, so the answer is never exposed to the browser before the game ends. A full admin dashboard covers users, games, word schedules, CSV word-list imports, analytics and an audit log, and the project is covered by Vitest integration tests and Playwright E2E tests with automated accessibility checks.
features: Multi-game daily puzzles: Wordle, Spelling Bee, Connections and more
Daily and 12-hourly word rotation with IST-based buckets
Deterministic HMAC fallback so every bucket resolves to a word
Admin word overrides that automation never overwrites
Wordle Unlimited drawing from a per-12-hour pool snapshot
Full admin dashboard: users, games, word lists, analytics and audit log
Secure auth with bcrypt, hashed session tokens and HTTP-only cookies
Server-side guess validation so answers are never leaked to the browser
Rate limiting, CSRF origin checks and hardened security headers
Guest play via signed anonymous cookie with optional sign-in
Vitest integration tests and Playwright E2E with axe accessibility checks
Automatic rotation via Vercel Cron plus an external 12-hour scheduler

title: StoreFlow — Product Management Dashboard
description: A premium product-management dashboard over the DummyJSON catalogue, built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4 — with a dark emerald glass design system and hand-built SVG charts.
detailedDescription: StoreFlow is a premium product-management dashboard built on the free DummyJSON catalogue. It presents a dark, emerald-accented glass design system with a collapsible sidebar, a compact glass topbar with command search, and a mobile bottom tab bar. The core Products workspace combines search, category filtering, sorting, page size and a table/grid view toggle, all driven by the URL so any view can be shared or refreshed without losing state. Around it sit a KPI dashboard, category analytics, a full analytics workspace with price-band charts and rating histograms, product detail pages with Overview/Reviews/Details tabs, and settings. Charts and sparklines are hand-built with SVG/CSS rather than a charting library, all HTTP calls go through one shared Axios instance, and local create/edit/delete overrides are merged over the real API data. The app tracks real API latency and connection state with 30-second polling that pauses when the tab is hidden, and route protection uses Next.js 16's renamed proxy middleware.

title: Stackcraft Blog
description: A full-stack developer-focused tech blog built with Next.js 16, featuring MDX posts, tag filtering, full-text search, and a dark glassmorphism design.
detailedDescription: A full-stack developer-focused tech blog where engineers read between the lines. Built with Next.js 16 App Router, it features 12 in-depth MDX blog posts covering AI, ML, cloud infrastructure, tech finance, DevOps, and tech jobs. The blog includes static site generation with pagination, tag-based filtering, full-text search across titles and excerpts, a reading progress bar, view counter via Neon PostgreSQL, and newsletter subscription. It solves the problem of creating a performant, content-rich technical publication with a dark-first glassmorphism design, comprehensive testing (Jest + Playwright), and automated CI/CD pipelines.

title: Grocery Shopping Site
description: A full-stack grocery e-commerce platform with Next.js 14, Express.js, PostgreSQL, user auth, cart management, and PDF invoice generation.
detailedDescription: A full-stack grocery e-commerce platform organized as a Turborepo monorepo with a Next.js 14 frontend and an Express.js/Prisma backend. The frontend features a modern grocery shopping experience with product browsing by category (vegetables, fruits, dairy, beverages, snacks, bakery, spices, meat), a fully functional shopping cart, user authentication, order management, and PDF invoice generation. The backend provides RESTful APIs with JWT authentication, Google OAuth, PostgreSQL database via Prisma ORM, and security middleware (helmet, CORS). Docker Compose orchestrates the PostgreSQL database and backend services for local development. It solves the complete problem of online grocery ordering with fresh food delivery, secure user accounts, and a seamless shopping experience.

title: PollCast — Live Polling & Q&A Platform
description: A production-grade real-time live polling and Q&A platform for events. Features live polls with instant results, moderated Q&A, and an analytics dashboard.
detailedDescription: A full-stack real-time polling and Q&A platform built for live events. Hosts can create interactive polls (single/multi-choice) with timers and auto-close, manage a moderated Q&A system with anonymous asking and upvoting, and monitor engagement through an analytics dashboard with participant counts and vote metrics. The platform uses Socket.IO with Redis pub/sub for instant WebSocket updates, PostgreSQL for relational data integrity, and JWT access/refresh tokens for secure authentication across frontend, backend, and WebSocket connections. A separate Express server handles persistent WebSocket connections, making it deployable across Vercel (frontend) and Railway (backend). Includes comprehensive testing with Jest, Supertest, and Playwright E2E tests, plus Sentry error monitoring.
